english: Then this is your shift: today’s chair, your next customer, and how your week is going. We remember your choice.
translation: Så får du din vagt: dagens stol, din næste kunde og hvordan din uge går. Vi husker dit valg.

english: Holiday, sick days and contract hours are managed by the shop under
translation: Ferie, sygedage og kontrakttimer administreres af salonen under

english: Deposits, card or pay-at-salon, weekly payouts.
translation: Depositum, kort eller betaling i salonen, ugentlige udbetalinger.

english: Pay online or at the salon. Reminders and directions included.
translation: Betal online eller i salonen. Påmindelser og rutevejledning er med.

english: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay — or simply pay at the salon.
translation: Kort, Apple Pay, Google Pay – eller bare betal i salonen.

english: Patch tests, consent and allergy notes handled before you arrive.
translation: Allergitest, samtykke og allerginoter klares, før du kommer.

english: Calendar, payments, team rota, stock and loyalty — one app, no setup fee.
translation: Kalender, betalinger, vagtplan, lager og loyalitet – én app, ingen oprettelsesgebyr.

english: Uses your taste profile (consent — GDPR Art. 22 explainable)
translation: Bruger din smagsprofil (samtykke – GDPR art. 22, forklarlig)

english: Rest is paid at the shop
This card number does not check out — please re-check it.
translation: Kortnummeret er ikke gyldigt – tjek det igen.

english: By confirming you authorize StyleNow Demo to collect this amount by SEPA direct debit (demo mandate).
translation: Ved at bekræfte giver du StyleNow Demo tilladelse til at trække beløbet via SEPA-direkte debitering (demomandat).

english: Demo checkout — no real charge is made and nothing you type leaves your browser. Only a masked label like “Visa ····4242” is kept.
translation: Demobetaling – der trækkes ingen rigtige penge, og intet du skriver forlader din browser. Kun en maskeret betegnelse som “Visa ····4242” gemmes.

english: Your whole configuration — team, hours, menu, rules, photos, billing, customer notes — as one JSON file you own. Download it before big changes; restore it if anything goes wrong.
translation: Hele din opsætning – team, åbningstider, menu, regler, fotos, fakturering, kundenoter – som én JSON-fil, du selv ejer. Download den før store ændringer, og gendan den, hvis noget går galt.

english: Tap an appointment to reschedule it, message the customer, or settle it.
translation: Tryk på en aftale for at flytte den, skrive til kunden eller afregne den.

english: Pick a range — the chart shows the trend, the panels split it by service, team member and payment method.
translation: Vælg en periode – diagrammet viser tendensen, og panelerne deler den op efter ydelse, teammedlem og betalingsmetode.

english: Gift cards sold show their outstanding balance — money received for work not yet delivered.
translation: Solgte gavekort viser deres udestående saldo – penge modtaget for arbejde, der endnu ikke er leveret.

english: The note field is yours alone — customers never see it.
translation: Notefeltet er kun dit – kunder ser det aldrig.

english: Open a row to jump straight into that customer’s message thread.
translation: Åbn en række for at gå direkte til kundens beskedtråd.

english: Every customer conversation for this shop, in one place.
translation: Alle kundesamtaler for denne salon ét sted.

english: “Can I move my appointment?” usually answers itself — customers can move bookings from their side.
translation: “Kan jeg flytte min tid?” besvarer sig oftest selv – kunder kan flytte bookinger fra deres side.

english: Roles, branches and weekly hours — the roster here is exactly what customers can book.
translation: Roller, afdelinger og ugentlige timer – vagtplanen her er præcis det, kunder kan booke.

english: Removing someone who still has booked customers opens a resolver first — nobody gets stranded.
translation: Fjerner du en, der stadig har bookede kunder, åbnes først en løsningsguide – ingen bliver glemt.

english: Approving leave lists every booked visit inside it, each one a tap to reassign or refund.
translation: Når du godkender fravær, vises alle bookede besøg i perioden, hver med ét tryk til at flytte eller refundere.

english: Billing details feed every receipt and e-invoice the shop issues.
translation: Faktureringsoplysninger bruges på alle kvitteringer og e-fakturaer, salonen udsteder.

english: Redeem at checkout — enter the code in the voucher field
translation: Indløs ved betaling – indtast koden i feltet til rabatkode

english: Redeem it at checkout on StyleNow — enter the code in the voucher field when booking at {shop}.
translation: Indløs det ved betaling på StyleNow – indtast koden i feltet til rabatkode, når du booker hos {shop}.

english: This gift card has been fully used.
Bought on this device. The recipient just needs the code — it works in the voucher field at checkout.
translation: Købt på denne enhed. Modtageren skal blot bruge koden – den virker i feltet til rabatkode ved betaling.

english: A gift card in two minutes — printable, mailable, redeemable at checkout.
translation: Et gavekort på to minutter – kan printes, sendes på mail og indløses ved betaling.

english: Outstanding balances are money received for services not yet delivered — a liability until redeemed.
translation: Udestående saldi er penge modtaget for ydelser, der endnu ikke er leveret – en forpligtelse, indtil de indløses.

english: {have} of {need} stamps — a full card makes the next visit free
translation: {have} af {need} stempler – et fuldt kort giver næste besøg gratis

english: Your loyalty program, funded by you: {n} completed visits within six months and the next one is free. Stamps and rewards are counted from real bookings — nothing to stamp by hand, nothing to forge.
translation: Dit loyalitetsprogram, finansieret af dig: {n} gennemførte besøg inden for seks måneder, og det næste er gratis. Stempler og belønninger tælles fra rigtige bookinger – intet at stemple i hånden, intet at forfalske.

english: A discount that only applies in your two emptiest day-parts of the last 30 days. Those times carry a badge, so customers see why they’re cheaper.
translation: En rabat, der kun gælder i dine to tomreste dagsperioder de seneste 30 dage. Disse tider får et mærke, så kunderne kan se, hvorfor de er billigere.
{shop} har sendt dig en undskyldningsvoucher på 5 €

english: Your data lives in this browser. Take it with you, or blank the personal parts in place.
translation: Dine data ligger i denne browser. Tag dem med dig, eller slet de personlige dele på stedet.

english: Blanks your name, phone, notes, memos and message texts everywhere. Amounts and dates stay, so the salons’ books still add up. Cannot be undone.
translation: Blanker dit navn, telefonnummer, noter, memoer og beskedtekster overalt. Beløb og datoer bliver, så salonernes regnskab stadig stemmer. Kan ikke fortrydes.
ingen aflysninger fra salonen i 90 dage

english: {n}× cancelled, {m}× moved late by the salon (90 days)
translation: {n}× aflyst, {m}× flyttet sent af salonen (90 dage)

english: Late cancel or move by the salon? A €5 sorry-voucher is issued automatically.
translation: Sen aflysning eller flytning fra salonens side? En undskyldningsvoucher på 5 € udstedes automatisk.

english: What the next shift must know…
Completed service revenue per stylist × their percent (set in the team editor). Tips are listed, never commissioned.
translation: Gennemført ydelsesomsætning pr. frisør × deres procent (angives i teameditoren). Drikkepenge vises, men giver aldrig provision.

english: This service involves colour chemistry and I have no recent patch test here. I understand the salon may do a quick test first or decline the treatment.
translation: Denne ydelse indebærer farvekemi, og jeg har ingen nylig allergitest her. Jeg forstår, at salonen kan lave en hurtig test først eller afvise behandlingen.

english: Patch test was done — remember it
Patch test recorded for this salon (valid 6 months)
translation: Allergitest registreret for denne salon (gyldig i 6 måneder)

english: No recent patch test on record for this customer
translation: Ingen nylig allergitest registreret for denne kunde

english: N visits of one service for a bundle price, paid up front. Uses are counted from real bookings — a card cannot be over-spent, and a cancellation returns the use automatically.
translation: N besøg af én ydelse til en pakkepris, betalt på forhånd. Brug tælles fra rigtige bookinger – et kort kan ikke overforbruges, og en aflysning giver brugen tilbage automatisk.

english: {sold} sold · {uses} visits outstanding · {eur} of prepaid work open
translation: {sold} solgt · {uses} besøg udestående · {eur} forudbetalt arbejde åbent

english: Pay once, come back on your terms.
translation: Betal én gang, kom igen når det passer dig.

english: Gift cards in bulk for your team or clients — one order, one invoice, a volume discount from 5 cards (5 %), 10 (10 %) or 20 (15 %). Every code redeems at full face value.
translation: Gavekort i større mængder til dit team eller dine kunder – én ordre, én faktura, mængderabat fra 5 kort (5 %), 10 (10 %) eller 20 (15 %). Hver kode indløses til fuld pålydende værdi.

english: Hand one code to each person — every code is an ordinary gift card at full face value, redeemable in the booking checkout.
translation: Giv én kode til hver person – hver kode er et almindeligt gavekort til fuld pålydende værdi, som kan indløses ved booking.

english: The payment page could not be opened just now. Your seat is still held — try again in a moment.
translation: Betalingssiden kunne ikke åbnes lige nu. Din plads er stadig reserveret – prøv igen om lidt.

english: Let guests settle at the counter — card or cash — instead of paying when they book. A deposit, where one is set, is still taken online: that is what holds the seat.
translation: Lad gæster betale i kassen – kort eller kontant – i stedet for ved booking. Et depositum, hvis der er et, tages stadig online: det er det, der holder pladsen.

english: Guests may pay at the salon
When would you like to pay?
Nothing is charged now. {amount} is due at the counter — card or cash, whichever suits.
translation: Der trækkes ikke noget nu. {amount} betales i kassen – kort eller kontant, som du foretrækker.

english: Signed before the seat is held, for colour and needle work. Leave empty to ask for nothing. The wording is stored with the booking exactly as it stood when it was signed.
translation: Underskrives, før pladsen reserveres, til farve- og nålearbejde. Lad stå tomt for ikke at spørge om noget. Teksten gemmes med bookingen præcis, som den lød, da den blev underskrevet.

english: I confirm I have no known allergy to the products named, and that I understand the result depends on my hair’s condition…
translation: Jeg bekræfter, at jeg ikke har kendt allergi over for de nævnte produkter, og at jeg forstår, at resultatet afhænger af mit hårs tilstand…

english: Type your full name to sign
translation: Skriv dit fulde navn for at underskrive

english: The last 90 days, from the reason people gave at the cancel. One is an anecdote; a pattern is a roster decision.
translation: De seneste 90 dage, ud fra den grund folk angav ved aflysningen. Én er en anekdote; et mønster er en beslutning om vagtplanen.

english: Customer announced they are about {n} min late
translation: Kunden har meldt, at vedkommende kommer ca. {n} min for sent

english: Withdrawn — the salon expects you on time.
translation: Trukket tilbage – salonen forventer dig til tiden.

english: Could not tell the salon — the thread is the reliable door.
translation: Kunne ikke give salonen besked – tråden er den sikre vej.

english: Custom work has no fixed menu price. Describe what you have in mind and the answer lands in your messages — no booking needed first.
translation: Skræddersyet arbejde har ingen fast menupris. Beskriv, hvad du har i tankerne, så lander svaret i dine beskeder – ingen booking nødvendig først.

english: A flat monthly fee for a standing discount on every visit. Recurring revenue for you, a reason to stop shopping around for them. (Demo: the fee is simulated, no money moves.)
translation: Et fast månedligt gebyr for en stående rabat på hvert besøg. Tilbagevendende omsætning for dig, en grund til ikke at shoppe rundt for dem. (Demo: gebyret er simuleret, ingen penge flyttes.)

english: Travels with this device, fills itself into every booking, and disappears with “erase my data”.
translation: Følger med denne enhed, udfyldes automatisk i hver booking og forsvinder med “slet mine data”.
fx PPD, ammoniak – adskilt med komma

english: Only promise what the premises actually have — customers plan their trip around this.
translation: Lov kun det, lokalerne faktisk har – kunder planlægger deres tur efter det.

english: Customers who saved their birthday get this discount automatically in the two weeks around it — a guaranteed annual visit occasion.
translation: Kunder, der har gemt deres fødselsdag, får automatisk denne rabat i de to uger omkring den – en garanteret årlig anledning til et besøg.

english: Colour service: first colour visit here? A patch test 48 h ahead is recommended — just message the salon.
translation: Farveydelse: første farvebesøg her? En allergitest 48 timer forinden anbefales – skriv bare til salonen.

english: Sell a gift card at the counter
Gift card created — hand over the code
Share your code. Your friend gets €5 off their first booking over €25 — and the moment it confirms, a €5 gift card lands on your account.
translation: Del din kode. Din ven får 5 € rabat på sin første booking over 25 € – og i det øjeblik den bekræftes, lander et gavekort på 5 € på din konto.

english: This treatment needs a signed consent, and there is only one consent field for the whole party — book each chair separately instead.
translation: Denne behandling kræver et underskrevet samtykke, og der er kun ét samtykkefelt til hele selskabet – book hver stol for sig i stedet.

english: The day’s money in one printable sheet — revenue, VAT, tips, fees, refunds, and the split by payment method. Derived live from the calendar, so it can never disagree with it.
translation: Dagens penge på ét udskrivbart ark – omsætning, moms, drikkepenge, gebyrer, refusioner og fordelingen efter betalingsmetode. Udledt live fra kalenderen, så det aldrig kan afvige fra den.
Drikkepenge (personale, uden for det skattepligtige beløb)
ai_review_note: zb_tips: 'uden for skattepligtigt total' was ungrammatical tax wording; corrected.

english: Derived from the day’s bookings at the moment of opening. Demo report — not a fiscal document (no TSE signature).
translation: Udledt af dagens bookinger i det øjeblik, rapporten åbnes. Demorapport – ikke et skattemæssigt dokument (ingen TSE-signatur).

english: Seat reserved — finish payment to keep it.
translation: Plads reserveret – afslut betalingen for at beholde den.

english: That time was just taken. Here are the nearest free alternatives:
translation: Den tid blev lige taget. Her er de nærmeste ledige alternativer:

english: ✅ Cancelled in time — {refund} refunded in full.
translation: ✅ Aflyst i tide – {refund} refunderet fuldt ud.

english: Surge is capped at +25 % platform-wide and never hits returning customers on repeat services.
translation: Tillæg er begrænset til +25 % på hele platformen og rammer aldrig tilbagevendende kunder ved gentagne ydelser.

english: Payment is settled at the shop — the seat is blocked immediately.
translation: Betaling afregnes i salonen – pladsen blokeres med det samme.

english: Type the name from the signed consent before booking this treatment.
translation: Skriv navnet fra det underskrevne samtykke, før du booker denne behandling.

english: Tip: click a free spot to add an appointment; click a booking to open it — details, phone, move, complete or cancel.
translation: Tip: klik på et ledigt sted for at tilføje en aftale; klik på en booking for at åbne den – detaljer, telefon, flyt, gennemfør eller aflys.

english: Shown to customers on your shop page and in search. PNG/JPG, squared works best.
translation: Vises for kunder på din salonside og i søgning. PNG/JPG, kvadratisk virker bedst.

english: Missing a category? Add your own
translation: Mangler du en kategori? Tilføj din egen

english: Running several salons? Add each location — they appear as one chain with separate calendars.
translation: Driver du flere saloner? Tilføj hver lokation – de vises som én kæde med separate kalendere.

english: Demonstration project — no real payments or appointments.
translation: Demonstrationsprojekt – ingen rigtige betalinger eller aftaler.

english: Booked as a business? German bookkeeping systems ingest structured e-invoices (E-Rechnung). This downloads the same receipt as machine-readable XRechnung XML (EN 16931). Private customers don’t need this — the receipt above is your document either way.
translation: Booket som virksomhed? Tyske bogføringssystemer indlæser strukturerede e-fakturaer (E-Rechnung). Dette downloader den samme kvittering som maskinlæsbar XRechnung-XML (EN 16931). Privatkunder behøver ikke dette – kvitteringen ovenfor er dit dokument i begge tilfælde.

english: Generated from this booking’s data and validated against the official KoSIT validator (XRechnung 3.0 rules + EN 16931). Demo notice: the salon data itself is demo data.
translation: Genereret ud fra denne bookings data og valideret mod den officielle KoSIT-validator (XRechnung 3.0-regler + EN 16931). Demobemærkning: selve salondataene er demodata.

english: They’re on your bookings page — each can be moved or cancelled on its own.
translation: De ligger på din bookingside – hver kan flyttes eller aflyses for sig.

english: Future visits are paid at the salon, visit by visit.
translation: Fremtidige besøg betales i salonen, besøg for besøg.

english: Tip (not part of the service price)
This receipt is issued by the salon. Keep it for expense claims — salons retain their copies for the statutory period.
translation: Denne kvittering er udstedt af salonen. Gem den til udgiftsrefusion – saloner opbevarer deres kopier i den lovpligtige periode.

english: What your receipts say. The legal name and tax number appear on every customer receipt.
translation: Hvad dine kvitteringer siger. Det juridiske navn og skattenummeret vises på hver kundekvittering.

english: Small business (§ 19 UStG) — receipts show no VAT, only the exemption note
translation: Lille virksomhed (§ 19 UStG) – kvitteringer viser ingen moms, kun fritagelsesnoten

english: That time was just taken — here is what’s still free
translation: Den tid blev lige taget – her er, hvad der stadig er ledigt

english: These customers are already booked into this period. Hand each visit to a free colleague, or cancel it with a full refund.
translation: Disse kunder er allerede booket i denne periode. Giv hvert besøg videre til en ledig kollega, eller aflys det med fuld refusion.

english: Moved to {name} — the customer has been notified
That colleague just got booked — list refreshed
translation: Den kollega blev lige booket – listen er opdateret

english: The shop is calling it off, so the customer pays nothing and gets everything back.
translation: Salonen aflyser, så kunden betaler intet og får alt tilbage.

english: No messages with this customer yet. Say hello — a short note before an appointment is the cheapest way to stop a no-show.
translation: Ingen beskeder med denne kunde endnu. Sig hej – en kort besked før en aftale er den billigste måde at undgå en udeblivelse på.

english: Replies are public on your shop page. Future customers read how you handle a bad day at least as closely as they read the rating.
translation: Svar er offentlige på din salonside. Fremtidige kunder læser, hvordan du håndterer en dårlig dag, mindst lige så nøje som vurderingen.

english: That time has just been taken
translation: Den tid er netop blevet taget

english: An offer shows on the customer’s bookings page for 30 minutes with that exact time. It doesn’t hold the seat — first come stays first served.
translation: Et tilbud vises på kundens bookingside i 30 minutter med netop den tid. Det reserverer ikke pladsen – først til mølle gælder stadig.

english: People who asked to be told when a day frees up. When a cancellation opens a slot, they are the first call to make.
translation: Folk, der har bedt om besked, når en dag frigives. Når en aflysning åbner en tid, er de de første at ringe til.

english: Click a day to book time off for that person; click an existing absence to remove it. Bars show how full a working day already is.
translation: Klik på en dag for at booke fri til den person; klik på et eksisterende fravær for at fjerne det. Linjer viser, hvor fuld en arbejdsdag allerede er.

english: An absence removes that person’s hours from the calendar, so no customer can book them while away.
translation: Et fravær fjerner personens timer fra kalenderen, så ingen kunde kan booke dem, mens de er væk.

english: Anything the shop should know? (allergies, wishes…)
translation: Er der noget, salonen bør vide? (allergier, ønsker…)

english: No customers yet — they appear here as soon as someone books.
translation: Ingen kunder endnu – de vises her, så snart nogen booker.

english: People are matched by phone number when they gave one, so the same customer stays one record across their phone, their laptop and the front desk. Private notes are yours alone — customers never see them.
translation: Personer matches via telefonnummer, når de har oplyst et, så samme kunde forbliver én post på tværs af telefon, bærbar og receptionen. Private noter er kun dine – kunder ser dem aldrig.

english: Shuts the whole shop — public holidays, renovation, the summer break. Nobody can be booked on these days, without touching anyone’s roster.
translation: Lukker hele salonen – helligdage, renovering, sommerferie. Ingen kan bookes de dage, uden at røre nogens vagtplan.

english: The rest is cut into start times on the shop’s slot grid, and each candidate must fit the whole service plus the before/after buffers.
translation: Resten skæres i starttider på salonens tidsgitter, og hver kandidat skal passe til hele ydelsen plus buffere før/efter.

english: At checkout the seat is held for 8 minutes and the database has the last word — a seat can only ever belong to one booking.
translation: Ved betaling reserveres pladsen i 8 minutter, og databasen har det sidste ord – en plads kan kun tilhøre én booking.

english: {name} still has upcoming appointments — reassign or cancel them below first.
translation: {name} har stadig kommende aftaler – tildel dem igen eller aflys dem nedenfor først.

english: Demo environment — bookings are simulated, no real payments.
translation: Demomiljø – bookinger er simulerede, ingen rigtige betalinger.

english: I accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy (required)
translation: Jeg accepterer vilkårene for brug og privatlivspolitikken (påkrævet)

english: Demo session — real OAuth activates once the provider is enabled in Supabase.
translation: Demosession – ægte OAuth aktiveres, når udbyderen er slået til i Supabase.

english: Almost there — confirm the link we just emailed you, then sign in.
translation: Næsten færdig – bekræft linket, vi lige har sendt dig på e-mail, og log så ind.

english: Everything stored about you — GDPR Art. 20.
translation: Alt, der er gemt om dig – GDPR art. 20.

english: Really delete your account and profile? Bookings history in shops stays for legal retention.
translation: Vil du virkelig slette din konto og profil? Bookinghistorik i saloner bevares af lovmæssige opbevaringshensyn.

english: This signs you out everywhere and removes your profile. It cannot be undone.
translation: Dette logger dig ud overalt og fjerner din profil. Det kan ikke fortrydes.

english: 🗑 Your profile, preferences and favourites are deleted.
translation: 🗑 Din profil, dine præferencer og favoritter slettes.

english: 🔒 Past receipts stay with the salons — German law requires them to keep invoices for the statutory retention period.
translation: 🔒 Tidligere kvitteringer bliver hos salonerne – tysk lov kræver, at de opbevarer fakturaer i den lovpligtige periode.

english: 📅 Upcoming appointments are NOT cancelled. Cancel them first if you do not want to go.
translation: 📅 Kommende aftaler aflyses IKKE. Aflys dem først, hvis du ikke vil møde op.

english: 📦 Download your data first — after this it is gone.
translation: 📦 Download dine data først – bagefter er de væk.

english: Account deleted. Sorry to see you go.
translation: Konto slettet. Vi er kede af at se dig gå.

english: 📅 Existing appointments stay booked — customers still expect you.
translation: 📅 Eksisterende aftaler forbliver booket – kunderne forventer dig stadig.

english: 🚫 You lose access immediately, on every device signed in to this account.
translation: 🚫 Du mister adgangen med det samme, på alle enheder logget ind på denne konto.

english: 📅 Appointments already booked with them are NOT cancelled — move them first.
translation: 📅 Aftaler, der allerede er booket hos vedkommende, aflyses IKKE – flyt dem først.

english: The slot is freed and the customer is notified.
translation: Tiden frigives, og kunden får besked.

english: ⚠️ Cancelling on the customer’s behalf skips the cancellation fee.
translation: ⚠️ Aflysning på kundens vegne springer aflysningsgebyret over.

english: Free to join · 12 % commission only on completed online bookings · payouts weekly via Stripe
translation: Gratis at deltage · 12 % provision kun på gennemførte onlinebookinger · ugentlige udbetalinger via Stripe

english: Small business (§19 UStG, no VAT shown)
translation: Lille virksomhed (§19 UStG, ingen moms vist)

english: We are a mobile service (no fixed location)
translation: Vi er en mobil tjeneste (ingen fast lokation)

english: Payouts run via Stripe Connect — you will verify ownership there.
translation: Udbetalinger kører via Stripe Connect – du bekræfter ejerskab dér.

english: I accept the Partner Terms and the data-processing agreement (AVV) (required)
I confirm the information is accurate and I am authorised to register this business.
translation: Jeg bekræfter, at oplysningerne er korrekte, og at jeg er bemyndiget til at registrere denne virksomhed.

english: We review every shop by hand — typically within 2 business days. You will hear from us at {email}.
translation: Vi gennemgår hver salon manuelt – typisk inden for 2 hverdage. Du hører fra os på {email}.

english: Please fill the highlighted required fields.
translation: Udfyld venligst de fremhævede obligatoriske felter.
